title: Interaction surface analytic schema and curated slices for Console usage
creator: Aanya Patel
description: Problem: Current console usage analytics are spread across many wide event tables and ad-hoc joins which make common queries (per-route SLA, weekly active customers by feature surface, and tail-latency cohorts) expensive and brittle. Goal: design and implement a compact, query-first schema called the Interaction Surface Layer (ISL) that produces pre-joined, time-partitioned curated slices tailored to Console UX and billing queries. The ISL focuses on: 1) interaction-level identity (route_id, workspace_id, session_fingerprint), 2) normalized feature surface tags (route_category, model_variant, call_type), 3) compact cost/latency histograms and decile markers, and 4) lightweight dimensional snapshots for rapid rollups. This ticket covers schema design, ETL contract, migration/backfill plan, and a minimal set of curated tables and views for power users and dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Schema document reviewed and approved by analytics and backend leads
ETL jobs implement dual-write for 2 weeks with no regressions on existing dashboards
Backfill completes within the backfill SLA window and validated against current canonical metrics (DAU, avg latency, token cost)
New curated tables reduce 95th percentile query latency for key dashboards by >= 3x
Security review completed for PII columns and KMS handling
implementation_notes: Primary compact tables: isl_interaction_events (wide but column-pruned), isl_session_summary (1 row per session per day), isl_cost_latency_rollup (pre-aggregated histograms).
Partitioning: date_day for all tables; secondary partition/bucketing on workspace_id for isl_session_summary to reduce hot partitions for large customers.
SCD strategy: route metadata in isl_route_dim will use SCD2 for model_variant and route_category. Session summaries are append-only with dedupe by (workspace_id, session_fingerprint, date_day).

Storage trade-off: we intentionally keep pre-aggregated histograms (compact 64-byte proto per-window) to speed queries at cost of ~10% storage increase vs raw events. Decision justified by operational query cost savings.
Query patterns prioritized: per-route SLA over past 7/30 days, workspace-level token spend by model_variant, experiment cohorts cross-join with feature flags.
Data contracts: source producers must supply stable session_fingerprint and canonical workspace_id; fallback logic defined for missing fingerprint (generate deterministic hash of invocation chain).
Quality checks: row counts vs source daily, value range checks on latency/cost columns, and schema drift alerts via existing data quality framework (ENG-63109).
migration_plan: Phase 1 (dual-write): 2-week dual-write from console-backend v1 into ISL staging tables; monitor diffs for key metrics
Phase 2 (backfill): use incremental windowed backfill for last 90 days; run full backfill for 365 days only if acceptance metrics pass
Phase 3 (switch): update dashboards and ETL consumers to read curated tables, keep raw pipeline for 30 days as fallback, then deprecate redundant derived views
Backout plan: if diffs > 0.5% on critical metrics or regression in dashboard performance, switch consumers back to canonical views and open incident runbook
Operational runbook: run data skew job nightly, trigger reingestion if dedupe failure rate > 0.1%
queries_to_validate: SELECT workspace_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_fingerprint) FROM isl_session_summary WHERE date_day BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY workspace_id LIMIT 100
SELECT route_id, percentile_approx(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM isl_interaction_events WHERE date_day BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY route_id
SELECT model_variant, SUM(token_cost) FROM isl_cost_latency_rollup WHERE date_day = CURRENT_DATE - 1 GROUP BY model_variant
Join validation: compare existing canonical DAU query against isl_session_summary DAU for last 30 days and assert <= 0.3% difference

2025-03-04 Ravi Kumar (analytics): Reviewed histogram proto and recommended reducing histogram buckets from 128 -> 32 to shrink storage while retaining 95th percentile accuracy. Marcus agreed; updated impl notes.

2025-03-07 Security review (Elena Morales): Flagged potential PII in invocation_path field. Decided to hash invocation_path with customer-specific salt and store only last 8 chars for debugging. Security review checklist added to artifacts.
2025-03-10 Ops (SLO): Ran a query performance test on a 30-day sample; isl_session_summary reduced dashboard load time from ~18s to ~4.2s. Captured results in validation dashboard.

2025-03-12 Marcus Chen: Started implementing backfill tooling. Hitting an edge-case where sessions spanning midnight result in duplicate session_fingerprint rows — added dedupe-by-window step to ETL. Assigned follow-up ENG-95902 for dedupe optimization.
